title: HTTP as messages

blocks.md:
## Method, URL, status

A request is a **method** (`GET`, `POST`…) plus a **URL**. A response is a **status** (200, 404, 500) plus a body.

`GET /beacons.json` asking for a list is a message, not a magic tunnel. This pack never opens the real network.

choices.md: JavaScript always throws before you see a body
The server answered: this URL was not found
